posts.content: I’m good. I’ll cooperate with everyone; cooperation among good players maximizes our shared total. Please cooperate unless you have evidence your opponent is selfish.

belief_records.strategy: Start with C: mutual cooperation between good players benefits the shared objective. Use encounter outcomes to guide later choices; claims alone are weak evidence.
Cooperate with good players to maximize their shared payoff; use encounter outcomes to inform later choices.
Cooperate initially; update beliefs and adapt to observed actions, cooperating with likely good players and avoiding exploitation by likely selfish players.
Cooperate with likely good players; update beliefs and future choices from observed encounter outcomes.
As a selfish player, maximize immediate payoff; defect against a stated cooperator. Marginal beliefs follow the role-conditioned count prior.
Defect to maximize my payoff in this one-time encounter; use cooperation claims as unverified.
Cooperate with a likely good opponent to maximize shared good-player payoffs; update beliefs and actions using observed encounter behavior.
Cooperate initially to support mutual cooperation among good players; use observed encounter actions to adapt in later rounds.
Cooperate with no evidence of defection; use encounter outcomes to update beliefs and reciprocate where doing so improves good players’ total payoff.
Build a cooperative reputation early, then exploit opportunities when future reputation costs are lower.

Cooperate with P3 absent contrary encounter evidence; mutual cooperation between good players best serves the shared objective. Treat declarations as weak evidence and use observed actions to guide later choices.
Cooperate with P10 absent contrary encounter evidence; use observed actions and credible encounter reports to guide later choices, while treating claims as uncertain.
Cooperate with likely good players to maximize their combined payoff; update identity beliefs using observed actions, treating promises as weaker evidence.
Use credible encounter reports to update identity beliefs; defect when the chance of facing a selfish player outweighs the shared benefit of mutual cooperation.
Defect to maximize my payoff: it earns at least as much as cooperation against either opponent action. Update role beliefs mainly from observed actions; treat unverified claims cautiously.
Defect in every encounter: it gives me a higher payoff than cooperation against either opponent action. Use the prior conditioned on my known selfish role; treat unverified claims cautiously.

Defect against opponents with credible evidence of defection; cooperate with likely good players to maximize good players’ combined payoff. Update beliefs from observed actions, treating claims as uncertain.
Cooperate absent strong evidence of defection; use reported encounter outcomes cautiously and adapt to observed actions.
Cooperate with no observed defection; update from encounter evidence and favor actions that maximize the total payoff of good players.
Defect to maximize my payoff regardless of P2’s action; keep identity beliefs near the role-conditioned prior because early cooperation and public claims are not conclusive evidence.

P3’s repeated report that P5 defected against cooperation is meaningful evidence, while P5’s promise is unverified. Defect if P5 is selfish; use observed outcomes and credible reports to update beliefs.
Defect against P6 given reports of prior defection; otherwise weigh observed actions over promises and choose to maximize the total payoff of good players.
Cooperate with likely good players to maximize their combined payoff. Treat P5’s observed defection and reports about P6/P10 as evidence, but discount unverified claims.

Defect against P5 given multiple reports of prior defection; update beliefs from observed outcomes and treat promises as uncertain.
